assertions.name: stage_c_per_block_chi_symbolic_matches_pyhecke
assertions.source: Stage C correctness gate: the symbolic Hoefsmit construction (sympy, exact q-rational) must reproduce the pyhecke 1-indexed χ^λ(σ_1·σ_2·σ_1) values at q_0 to ≥ 12 dps. PASS confirms the closed forms (q^3, 0, -q^(-3)) are correct, anchoring the no-float64 operator-level extraction toward c_4..c_8.

description: Stage C closed form: per-block χ^λ(σ_1σ_2σ_1) at n=3 derived symbolically via the Hoefsmit construction. Yields exact q-monomial closed forms (q^3, 0, -q^(-3)) for (3), (2,1), (1,1,1) respectively. No float64. The (2,1) = 0 is structural (exact cancellation in the 2×2 rep trace). Closes the per-block χ^λ extraction for the operator-level N=k probe.

word_used.correction_from_pr_1851: PR #1851 used 0-indexed input which caused idx=-1 to silently skip out-of-range; the validated values there were tr(σ_1), not tr(trefoil).

structural_finding.proof_sketch: In Hoefsmit (2,1), σ_1·σ_2·σ_1 trace = q²·a + a'/q² with a = -1/(q(q²+1)), a' = q^3/(q²+1) ⇒ -q/(q²+1) + q/(q²+1) = 0.

verdict.next_step: Substitute u = b(q)·ℏ_q² and expand each per-block χ^λ around q_0 to extract operator-level N=k coefficients (a_k_λ). With pure q-monomial χ^λ, this is binomial-expansion-easy.
